item.description:
A story waiting to be lived.

Inspired by the timeless Montana style, this remarkable estate blends grandeur with contemporary elegance. A home built not just for living, but for belonging.

As the sun sets across the estate, generations gather with grandparents sharing stories by the stone fireplace, and laughter echoes through the home. Every inch of this residence has been designed for connection, for shared meals, for slow mornings, for the kind of family moments that become legacy.

Inside, soaring high coffered ceilings, warm natural textures capture the essence of living, while modern comforts, multiple living zones, and luxurious accommodations cater effortlessly to multigenerational needs. Whether it's adult children with their children, guests staying long term, or family celebrations under the stars - this home welcomes them all. Your loved ones will gravitate naturally toward places to be together, yet still have room to breathe. This estate is made to host a lifetime of moments and memories.

Private and luxurious master wing, a complete sanctuary of walk in dressing robes, sumptuous ensuite, and views across the landscape. Each additional bedroom has generous proportions, ensuring comfort for every generation.

Beyond the home is the acreage lifestyle dream. With its impressive street presence, circular driveway, and broad entertaining domains, this is a property that commands attention - a true trophy home for those who value both scale and soul.

Acreage living redefined. A home like this is not built overnight, it's hand crafted, cherished, and handed down. This is where life slows down, hearts come together, and family truly comes home. 

An acreage estate lifestyle you'll fall in love with.

Once you see, you can't unsee.

 Montana inspired architecture with light filled accents and stone features
 7 Bedrooms, 8 Bathrooms
 1,850 m² of living space designed to impress, entertain & embrace
generations

 Private and usable acreage in a blue ribbon position
